literal: Whatever benefits the people and profits the state, report it in full.
idiomatic: Whatever benefits the people and profits the state, report it in full.

literal: On the renwu day, the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the renwu day the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the jiashen day, because the two silkworm crops of Chang'an mostly died, half the year's levy was remitted to the people.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day, because the two silkworm crops of Chang'an mostly died, half the year's levy was remitted to the people.

literal: Ninth month, day dinghai: a partial amnesty in the capital.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dinghai day, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

literal: Goryeo, Kumo Xi, Khitan, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Goryeo, Kumo Xi, Khitan, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the guichou day, the states of Dangchang and Sogdiana each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the guichou day the states of Dangchang and Sogdiana each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day dingsi: the Seven Treasures Yong'an traveling hall was begun.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingsi day, the Seven Treasures Yong'an traveling hall was begun.

literal: On the yichou day, Acting General Who Campaigns West, Acting Prince of Dongyang Yuan Pi, was advanced to full prince.
idiomatic: On the yichou day Yuan Pi, acting general who campaigns west and acting Prince of Dongyang, was advanced to full prince.

literal: On the jiwei day, an edict said: "We inherit the imperial apex and illumine the myriad realms, thinking to spread distant customs and shine on the trillion subjects, so that at court there is no speech that may not be spoken and in the wilds no sound that is self-concealed—we consult the imperial charge and inquire even of the grass and firewood.
idiomatic: On the jiwei day an edict said, "We inherit the imperial apex and illumine the myriad realms, thinking to spread distant customs and shine on the trillion subjects, so that at court there is no speech that may not be spoken and in the wilds no sound that is self-concealed—we consult the imperial charge and inquire even of the grass and firewood.

literal: From this time forward, officials, ministers, and down to clerks and people, [5] each may submit memorials, speak bluntly and remonstrate to the utmost, and hide nothing.
idiomatic: From this time forward, officials, ministers, and down to clerks and people, [5] each may submit memorials, speak bluntly and remonstrate to the utmost, and hide nothing.

literal: Whatever is expedient, benefits rule and profits the people, and can rectify customs, the offices are to report.
idiomatic: Whatever is expedient, benefits rule and profits the people, and can rectify customs, the offices are to report.

literal: We shall personally review and discuss its feasibility with the Three Excellencies, then judge and employ it."
idiomatic: We shall personally review and discuss its feasibility with the Three Excellencies, then judge and employ it."

literal: On the xinwei day, the imperial carriage visited Jianming Buddhist Temple and greatly pardoned criminals.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day the imperial carriage visited Jianming Buddhist Temple and greatly pardoned criminals.

literal: Duke of Jinan Luo Ba was advanced to prince.
idiomatic: Luo Ba, Duke of Jinan, was advanced to prince.

literal: Eleventh month: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the wuzi day, Grand Commandant, Prince of Anle Changle, was made inspector of Dingzhou; Zitui, Prince of Jingzhao and inspector of Qingzhou; Li Xin, minister of works, inspector of Xuzhou—all with staffs and equipage equal to the Three Directors.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day Changle, grand commandant and Prince of Anle, was made inspector of Dingzhou; Zitui, Prince of Jingzhao and inspector of Qingzhou; and Li Xin, minister of works, inspector of Xuzhou—all with staffs and equipage equal to the Three Directors.

literal: First year of Taihe, spring, first month, day yiyou new moon: an edict said: "We from youth inherit the precious enterprise and fear we cannot bear it, yet Heaven's gifts all arrive and earthly omens respond together; wind is harmonious and qi mild; Heaven and man join in accord.
idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month of spring of the first year of Taihe, on the yiyou day, an edict said, "We from youth inherit the precious enterprise and fear we cannot bear it, yet Heaven's gifts all arrive and earthly omens respond together; wind is harmonious and qi mild; Heaven and man join in accord.

literal: How could Our immaturity alone bring this about?
idiomatic: How could our immaturity alone bring this about?

literal: It is truly because the spirits and the seven temples bestowed their blessing.
idiomatic: It is truly because the spirits and the seven temples bestowed their blessing.

literal: Now the three beginnings are announced at the start; reverent feeling is keenly joined—fittingly, following yang's beginning, harmonize the canon and reform the origin: change the present era name to the first year of Taihe."
idiomatic: Now the three beginnings are announced at the start; reverent feeling is keenly joined—fittingly, following yang's beginning, harmonize the canon and reform the origin: change the present era name to the first year of Taihe."

literal: On the xinhai day, an edict said: "Those who pasture the people today govern the realm together with Us.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day an edict said, "Those who pasture the people today govern the realm together with us.

literal: Corvée should be simplified, encouragement put first, water and land be surveyed, and full use be made of the land's advantage, so that farmers spread outward and mulberry women labor within.
idiomatic: Corvée should be simplified, encouragement put first, water and land be surveyed, and full use be made of the land's advantage, so that farmers spread outward and mulberry women labor within.

literal: If corvée is lightly issued and the people's seasons are seized, judge it as encroachment and usurpation.
idiomatic: If corvée is lightly issued and the people's seasons are seized, judge it as encroachment and usurpation.

literal: People who do not follow the chief's teaching and are idle in farming and sericulture are to be punished.
idiomatic: People who do not follow the chief's teaching and are idle in farming and sericulture are to be punished.

literal: The Taihe and Anchang halls were begun.
idiomatic: The Taihe and Anchang halls were begun.

literal: On the jiyou day, Wang Yuanshou of Lueyang in Qinzhou gathered more than five thousand households and styled himself Chongtian King.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day Wang Yuanshou of Lueyang in Qinzhou gathered more than five thousand households and styled himself Chongtian King.

literal: Yunzhong suffered famine; granaries were opened for relief.
idiomatic: Yunzhong suffered famine; granaries were opened for relief.

literal: Second month, day bingyin: the people of Hanchuan, Quan Hui, Tan You, and others led one another inward and were settled in Bingzhou.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingyin day, the people of Hanchuan, Quan Hui, Tan You, and others led one another inward and were settled in Bingzhou.

literal: On the xinwei day, Wei Luohou, inspector of Qin and Yi provinces and Duke of Wudu, defeated Yuanshou, captured his wife and children, and sent them to the capital.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day Wei Luohou, inspector of Qin and Yi provinces and Duke of Wudu, defeated Yuanshou, captured his wife and children, and sent them to the capital.

literal: On the guiwei day, Goryeo, Khitan, and Kumo Xi each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day Goryeo, Khitan, and Kumo Xi each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Third month, day gengzi: General Who Campaigns West, Inspector of Yong Province, Prince of Dongyang Pi, was summoned and made Minister of Works.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengzi day, Pi, general who campaigns west, inspector of Yong province, and Prince of Dongyang, was summoned and made minister of works.

literal: On the bingwu day, an edict said: "Our rule has many gaps and calamities have repeatedly arisen.
idiomatic: On the bingwu day an edict said, "Our rule has many gaps and calamities have repeatedly arisen.

literal: Last year cattle pestilence killed more than half; the profit of plowing must have suffered loss.
idiomatic: Last year cattle pestilence killed more than half; the profit of plowing must have suffered loss.

literal: Now eastern work has begun and the people must practice their occupations.
idiomatic: Now eastern work has begun and the people must practice their occupations.

literal: Charge the local supervisors to urge farming: those with cattle must labor more diligently than in ordinary years; those without cattle must pay double hired labor beyond other years.
idiomatic: Charge the local supervisors to urge farming: those with cattle must labor more diligently than in ordinary years; those without cattle must pay double hired labor beyond other years.

literal: One adult man is to cultivate forty mu; a secondary adult twenty mu.
idiomatic: One adult man is to cultivate forty mu; a secondary adult twenty mu.

literal: Do not let people have surplus strength while land has neglected profit."
idiomatic: Do not let people have surplus strength while land has neglected profit."

literal: Kumo Xi and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Kumo Xi and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingyin: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingyin day, the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the dingmao day, the court visited Mount Baideng.
idiomatic: On the dingmao day the court visited Mount Baideng.

literal: On the renshen day, the court visited Mount Guo.
idiomatic: On the renshen day the court visited Mount Guo.

literal: Prince of Le'an Liang died.
idiomatic: Prince of Le'an Liang died.

literal: An edict restored the former Prince of Dongjun Lu Dingguo's office and rank.
idiomatic: An edict restored the former Prince of Dongjun Lu Dingguo's office and rank.

literal: Fifth month, day yiyou: the imperial carriage prayed for rain at Mount Wuzhou; soon timely rain fell abundantly.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yiyou day, the imperial carriage prayed for rain at Mount Wuzhou; soon timely rain fell abundantly.

literal: The Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day renchen: Attendant-in-Ordinary, General with Staff and Equipage Equal to the Three Directors, Inspector of Qing Province, Prince of Jingzhao Zitui, died.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renchen day, Zitui, attendant-in-ordinary, general with staff and equipage equal to the Three Directors, inspector of Qing province, and Prince of Jingzhao, died.

literal: On the gengzi day, three grades of capital punishment were fixed.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day three grades of capital punishment were fixed.

literal: On the jiyou day, the Taihe and Anchang halls were completed.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day the Taihe and Anchang halls were completed.

literal: The Zhuming and Sixian gates were begun.
idiomatic: The Zhuming and Sixian gates were begun.

literal: That month the younger Liu Yu died; his younger brother Liu Zhun usurped the throne.
idiomatic: That month the younger Liu Yu died; his younger brother Liu Zhun usurped the throne.

literal: Eighth month, day renzi: a general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renzi day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: On the bingzi day, an edict said: "Artisans, merchants, and menials each have their station, yet the offices have been lax and some have stained the pure current.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day an edict said, "Artisans, merchants, and menials each have their station, yet the offices have been lax and some have stained the pure current.

literal: From this time, within the household those with corvée labor are to be referred up to their department chief, [6] and below appointment follows rank in order.
idiomatic: From this time, within the household those with corvée labor are to be referred up to their department chief, [6] and below appointment follows rank in order.

literal: Those who rely on founding merit and settled the state by toil are not subject to this regulation."
idiomatic: Those who rely on founding merit and settled the state by toil are not subject to this regulation."

literal: On the wuyin day, Liu Zhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day Liu Zhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Ninth month, day guiwei: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guiwei day, the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the yiyou day, an edict that the assembled ministers fix laws and ordinances in the Taihua Hall.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day an edict ordered the assembled ministers to fix laws and ordinances in the Taihua Hall.

literal: On the xinmao day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the gengzi day, the Yongle touring-view hall was begun in the northern park, and the Divine Abyss pool was dug.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day the Yongle touring-view hall was begun in the northern park, and the Divine Abyss pool was dug.

literal: The states of Chaduo, western Tianzhu, Shewei, and Diefuluo each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The states of Chaduo, western Tianzhu, Shewei, and Diefuluo each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Tenth month, day guiyou: the capital's elderly seventy and above were feasted in the Taihua Hall and given clothing.
idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the guiyou day, the capital's elderly seventy and above were feasted in the Taihua Hall and given clothing.

literal: That month, Kumo Xi and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: That month Kumo Xi and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Another edict that those seventy and above had one son exempt from service.
idiomatic: Another edict held that those seventy and above had one son exempt from service.

literal: The state of Kucha sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The state of Kucha sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Yang Wendu, garrison commander of Jialu in Liu Zhun's realm, sent his younger brother Shu to raid and seize Chouchi.
idiomatic: Yang Wendu, garrison commander of Jialu in Liu Zhun's realm, sent his younger brother Shu to raid and seize Chouchi.

literal: On the bingzi day, Li Xin, inspector of Xuzhou, was executed.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day Li Xin, inspector of Xuzhou, was executed.

literal: Kumo Xi and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Kumo Xi and the Khitan state each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Eleventh month, day guiwei: an edict that General Who Campaigns West, Duke of Guangchuan Pi Huanxi; General Who Pacifies the West Liang Chounu; General Who Pacifies the West Yang Lingzhen, and others, led forty thousand troops to campaign against Yang Shu.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guiwei day, an edict ordered Pi Huanxi, general who campaigns west and Duke of Guangchuan; Liang Chounu, general who pacifies the west; Yang Lingzhen, general who pacifies the west; and others to lead forty thousand troops to campaign against Yang Shu.

literal: On the yiyou day, the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the dinghai day, Yi Qigou of Huai province styled himself descendant of Yao and King Who Responds, gathering a multitude at Chong Mountain.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day Yi Qigou of Huai province styled himself descendant of Yao and King Who Responds, gathering a multitude at Chong Mountain.

literal: Feng Xi, inspector of Luozhou, attacked and destroyed them.
idiomatic: Feng Xi, inspector of Luozhou, attacked and destroyed them.

literal: Intercalary month: Huanxi and the other armies reached Jian'an; Yang Shu abandoned the city and fled south.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month Huanxi and the other armies reached Jian'an; Yang Shu abandoned the city and fled south.

literal: On the guihai day, the state of Sutipo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the guihai day the state of Sutipo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the gengzi day, an edict that Acting Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Li Changren was envoy to Liu Zhun.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day an edict named Li Changren, acting palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoy to Liu Zhun.

literal: Twelfth month, day renyin: Huanxi captured Jialu, beheaded Wendu, and sent his head to the capital.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renyin day, Huanxi captured Jialu, beheaded Wendu, and sent his head to the capital.

literal: On the jiachen day, the states of Yuan Kuo and Tuyuhun each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day the states of Yuan Kuo and Tuyuhun each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the dingwei day, an edict that in eight provinces and commanderies that suffered flood, drought, and locusts and where the people were hungry, granaries were opened for relief.
idiomatic: On the dingwei day an edict ordered granaries opened for relief in eight provinces and commanderies that suffered flood, drought, and locusts and where the people were hungry.

literal: Prince of Anding Xiu was made with equipage equal to the Three Directors.
idiomatic: Xiu, Prince of Anding, was granted equipage equal to the Three Directors.

literal: Second year, spring, first month, day dingsi: Shixing, second son of Prince of Changli Feng Xi, was enfeoffed Prince of Beiping.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the dingsi day, Shixing, second son of Feng Xi, Prince of Changli, was enfeoffed Prince of Beiping.

literal: On the wuwu day, Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Second month, day dinghai: the court traveled to the hot springs of Dai.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the dinghai day, the court traveled to the hot springs of Dai.

literal: Where it passed it inquired into the people's hardships and gave palace women to poor men without wives.
idiomatic: Where it passed it inquired into the people's hardships and gave palace women to poor men without wives.

literal: On the wuxu day, the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the wuxu day the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the guimao day, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the guimao day the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

literal: Third month, day bingzi: Liang Miji, Duke of Henan, was made Prince of Dangchang.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingzi day, Liang Miji, Duke of Henan, was made Prince of Dangchang.

literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiashen: the court visited Mount Guo.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiashen day, the court visited Mount Guo.

literal: On the dinghai day, returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day the court returned to the palace.

literal: On the jichou day, Liu Zhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the jichou day Liu Zhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: The capital suffered drought.
idiomatic: The capital suffered drought.

literal: [7] On the jiachen day, prayed against heavenly calamity in the northern park and personally performed the rites.
idiomatic: [7] On the jiachen day the emperor prayed against heavenly calamity in the northern park and personally performed the rites.

literal: Food was reduced and the main hall avoided.
idiomatic: Food was reduced and the main hall avoided.

literal: On the bingwu day, timely rain fell abundantly.
idiomatic: On the bingwu day timely rain fell abundantly.

literal: A partial amnesty in the capital.
idiomatic: A partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

literal: Fifth month, an edict said: "When betrothal gifts exceed ritual, marriage and taking wives suffer the harm of missing the season;
idiomatic: In the fifth month an edict said, "When betrothal gifts exceed ritual, marriage and taking wives suffer the harm of missing the season;

literal: when burial and seeing off the dead are lavish, the living suffer the pain of wasted expense.
idiomatic: when burial and seeing off the dead are lavish, the living suffer the pain of wasted expense.

literal: The sage kings knew this and therefore extended them with ritual numbers and bound them with legal prohibitions.
idiomatic: The sage kings knew this and therefore extended them with ritual numbers and bound them with legal prohibitions.

literal: Lately the people have gradually turned to luxury; marriage and burial overstep the track, making rich and poor vie in height and noble and base without distinction.
idiomatic: Lately the people have gradually turned to luxury; marriage and burial overstep the track, making rich and poor vie in height and noble and base without distinction.

literal: Moreover imperial clans, noble kin, and scholar-official households, heedless of clan, marry down to unworthy classes.
idiomatic: Moreover imperial clans, noble kin, and scholar-official households, heedless of clan, marry down to unworthy classes.

literal: [8] The former emperor personally issued a bright edict establishing prohibitions by statute, yet the people clung to custom and still did not reform.
idiomatic: [8] The former emperor personally issued a bright edict establishing prohibitions by statute, yet the people clung to custom and still did not reform.

literal: We now reverence the old canon and reverently follow the former system, inscribing it in laws and ordinances as an eternal standard.
idiomatic: We now reverence the old canon and reverently follow the former system, inscribing it in laws and ordinances as an eternal standard.
